description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachment entity class which represents employee attachment records within the HRM system. It maps to the 'hs_hr_emp_attachment' database table, encapsulating properties like filename, description, attachment data, associated employee, and metadata such as attached time and who attached the record. The class includes methods for setting and getting these properties and uses Doctrine ORM for object-relational mapping. It also integrates traits for date-time handling and decorator functionalities.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachment
